messages.author: 0a6a97efcaf21ef3
messages.subject: Shiny IO - App successfully deployed but disconnects from server
parts:
I used the rsconnect package to deploy a Shiny App, and according to the output the app was successfully deployed to https://mar87.shinyapps.io/ShinyApp/. However, any visiting user sees the message "Disconnected from the server." The output from the DeployApp() function is at the end. I am not very familiar with deploy apps, so apologies if this is something very obvious.

Thanks!
